scope: City of Pittsburgh, 2020 census tracts whose land is mostly inside the city limits
notes: Single source of truth for scoring, read by src/visionpitts/scoring.py and app/src/lib/scoring.ts. Factor values are OBSERVED DATA: 0-1 percentile ranks across City of Pittsburgh tracts, computed in Python. The fit matrix, weights and presets are VALUE JUDGMENTS and are labeled as such everywhere they appear.

factors.label: Affordability need
factors.description: Renter households at or below 50% of area median income (HUD CHAS, HAMFI). Count, ranked across city tracts.

factors.label: Market strength
factors.description: Reinvestment Fund Market Value Analysis category in 2021 (80%) plus the direction of change since 2016 (20%).
factors.direction_note: Higher = stronger or rising housing market

factors.label: Displacement risk
factors.description: Composite of CDC Social Vulnerability Index (0.3), CHAS cost burden among renters ≤50% AMI (0.3), eviction filing rate (0.2) and vouchers per renter household (0.2). Each part is percentile-ranked; weights renormalize over the parts a tract has.
factors.direction_note: Higher = more residents vulnerable to displacement

factors.label: Subsidy eligibility
factors.description: 1 if the tract is a LIHTC Qualified Census Tract, a Small-Area Difficult Development Area, an Opportunity Zone, or a CDBG-eligible area.
factors.direction_note: 1 = at least one subsidy designation applies

factors.label: Transit access
factors.description: Weekday Pittsburgh Regional Transit departures from stops within 400 m of the tract, per acre of tract land. Ranked across city tracts.

factors.label: Flood exposure
factors.description: Share of tract land inside a HAND-derived inundation footprint (screening model, not FEMA).
factors.direction_note: Higher = more land exposed to flooding

fit.label: VALUE JUDGMENT. How much each typology benefits from a high value of each factor (+) or from a low value (−). Magnitude 0–1. Editable; recorded in docs/assumptions.md.

scoring.formula: S(t,k) = sum_f w_f * c(x_tf, d_kf) / sum_f w_f * |d_kf|, over factors with data and w_f > 0. c = d*x if d >= 0 else |d|*(1-x). Dividing by |d| makes S a weighted-average fit in [0,1] so typologies with larger fit totals are not favored.

presets.label: Anti-displacement
presets.blurb: Protect vulnerable renters first; market strength matters less.

presets.label: Market-led
presets.blurb: Go where unsubsidized construction can work.

presets.label: Transit-first
presets.blurb: Put homes where the buses already run.

confidence.rule: Start from data age vs 2026: <=2 yrs high, 3-5 medium, >5 low. Downgrade one level (never below low) for: coverage < 90%, dominant 2010->2020 crosswalk share < 0.8, CV > 30%, or an imputed/missing component.

pressure.label: OBSERVED, derived. market_pressure = queen-contiguity spatial lag of market_strength minus own market_strength. Positive = neighbors are stronger. Not a scoring factor; drives the market-pressure map mode and the watch list.
pressure.bivariate: need tercile (L/M/H) x market change direction (falling/flat/rising from MVA 2016->2021); watch list = H-rising.

bins.note: Fixed choropleth breaks for 0-1 scores, identical across scenarios so colors compare.
